reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: Manchester City FC are favoured at 59%, against 21% for SSC Napoli and 20% for the draw. Manchester City FC carry 65 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: Manchester City FC 1.2 points per game, SSC Napoli 0.8. They average 1.5 points per game at home this season.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.96 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 76%. Across their last five, Manchester City FC and SSC Napoli have scored 1.8 and conceded 2.1 a game between them.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.

limitations: Only 3 league matches of this season behind the weaker-evidenced side, so form leans on last season.
